g.title: Face - top view
g.desc: Parallel passes sweep across the stock top.

g.title: 2D Contour - top view
g.desc: The tool centre follows an offset outside one closed wall.
g.text: One offset wall ride per level

g.title: 2D Pocket - top view
g.desc: A zigzag pattern clears inside a closed pocket boundary.

g.title: 2D Adaptive - top view
g.desc: Looping adaptive cuts advance through a pocket at low engagement.

g.title: 2D Offset - top view
g.desc: Nested offset rings clear inward from the pocket boundary.

g.title: Slot - top view
g.desc: Straight passes clear a slot between the two authored endpoints.
g.text: Straight passes between A and B

g.title: Trochoidal slot - top view
g.desc: Overlapping loops advance along the length of a wider slot.

g.title: Trace - top view
g.desc: A centreline pass follows an open picked chain without cutter offset.
g.text: Tool centre follows the picked chain

g.title: Engrave - top view
g.desc: The tool centre traces letter strokes at the engraving depth.

g.title: 2D Chamfer - section
g.desc: The cone flank contacts the top edge along the chamfer ride.
g.text: Section: cone flank on the edge

g.title: Circular - top view
g.desc: Concentric circular passes clear a pocket about the authored centre.

g.title: Thread milling - oblique view
g.desc: A helical cutter path descends around an internal thread wall.
g.text: Helix: one pitch of depth per turn

g.title: Drill - section
g.desc: The drill feeds axially into the hole and retracts above it.

g.title: Bore - top view
g.desc: An end mill smaller than the hole circles its inside wall.
g.text: End mill interpolates inside the hole

g.title: 3D Pocket - oblique view
g.desc: Successive levels clear around the model while leaving its central island.

g.title: 3D Finish - oblique view
g.desc: Parallel finishing passes follow the height of a curved model surface.

g.title: Deburr - oblique view
g.desc: An edge break follows the exposed curved edge of the model.

g.title: 5-Axis Contour - oblique view
g.desc: Waterline rings descend around the wall with changing tool axes.
g.text: Waterline rings with tool axis samples

g.title: 5-Axis Parallel - oblique view
g.desc: Parallel passes follow surface height while the tool axis leans.
g.text: Raster passes with tool axis samples

g.title: 5-Axis Flow - oblique view
g.desc: Curved finishing passes follow the surface flow with leaning tool axes.

g.title: Multi-Axis Contour - oblique view
g.desc: The ball follows a picked three dimensional edge with a changing axis.
g.text: Picked 3D edge with tool axis samples

g.title: Swarf - oblique view
g.desc: Straight passes follow the ruling with the cutter flank against the wall.

g.title: Advanced Swarf - oblique view
g.desc: Successive swarf stages approach the nominal ruled surface.
g.text: Coarse stage followed by finish stage

g.title: Rotary Contour - axis shown horizontally
g.desc: Circumferential passes form rings around the fitted rotation axis.

g.title: Rotary Parallel - oblique view
g.desc: Axial finishing passes step around a horizontally mounted turned bar.

g.title: Rotary Offset - oblique view
g.desc: Wrapped roughing rings peel successive radial layers from the work.
g.text: Wrapped paths at successive radial depths

g.title: Multi-Axis Rough - oblique view
g.desc: Pocket levels clear around the model with tool axes leaning near walls.
g.text: Pocket levels with tool axis samples

g.title: Turning Facing - axial section
g.desc: Radial cutting passes remove material from the end of the rotating bar.
g.text: Radial passes across the bar end

g.title: Profile Rough - axial section
g.desc: Axial roughing passes remove radial shells above the final profile.

g.title: Profile Finish - axial section
g.desc: One finish pass follows the external turned profile with a nose offset.
g.text: One ride along the external profile

g.title: Groove Rough - axial section
g.desc: Blade plunges at several axial stations rough a groove to depth.
g.text: Repeated radial plunges across the band

g.title: Groove Finish - axial section
g.desc: Full depth blade plunges finish the groove at each axial station.

g.title: Part - axial section
g.desc: A blade plunges at one station through the rotation axis to sever the bar.
g.text: One station; cut through the axis

g.title: Threading - developed surface
g.desc: Spindle synchronized axial passes follow the thread at increasing radial depths.

g.title: Turning Chamfer - axial section
g.desc: The insert nose crosses a short modeled cone at the bar edge.
g.text: One ride across the modeled chamfer

g.title: Taper - axial section
g.desc: The insert follows the modeled cone between the two stated diameters.
g.text: One ride along the modeled taper

g.title: Multi-Pass - axial section
g.desc: Roughing shells precede successively closer rides of the final profile.
g.text: Rough shells followed by finish rides

g.title: Form - axial section
g.desc: A shaped tool plunges radially to reproduce the modeled formed surface.
g.text: Form tool plunges to the model surface

g.title: Turning Bore - axial section
g.desc: A boring bar enters the open hole then finishes its inside wall.
g.text: Axial entry; inside wall finish ride

g.title: Probe - section
g.desc: The stylus approaches a face and measures contact without cutting stock.
g.text: Measurement stroke and back-off; no cutting

g.title: Plasma Profile - top view
g.desc: A lead from the pierce point joins a closed through cut around the sheet profile.

g.title: Wire Contour - top view
g.desc: A straight lead joins a closed die cut from a start hole inside the slug.
g.text: Example: die cut from an internal start hole

g.title: Sinker Burn - section
g.desc: The electrode feeds down into the cavity and then retracts vertically.

g.title: Sinker Side Burn - section
g.desc: After the plunge the electrode moves toward one wall and returns.
g.text: Plunge, lateral burn, return and retract
